_comment: Accessory database for Null's Addons' Magical Power planner. Almost no accessories are Bazaar-tradable (verified against the live API), so the two live-priceable levers are: (1) the few Bazaar accessories below, and (2) the Recombobulator 3000 (computed in-engine from its live price, applied to accessories you already own). Entries WITH an 'acquire' block are priced and ranked in the buy/craft list; entries WITHOUT one are still used to identify owned accessories and to suggest specific Recombobulator upgrades. Add your own: give an id, family, rarity, and either {"bazaar": "<PRODUCT_ID>"}, {"craft": [["<MAT_ID>", qty], ...]} (priced from live Bazaar mats), or {"npc": <coins>}. Every id is validated live; a bad one is skipped.
